name: Munnar
summary: Tea gardens fold around the ridges of the Western Ghats. Start early along the estate roads, when passing mist lifts to reveal the valley below.

attractions.title: Tea Museum
attractions.text: Learn how the leaves are rolled and dried

attractions.title: Mattupetty Dam
attractions.text: Walk the basin and look for birds on the far shore

attractions.title: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.text: Reserve the park shuttle and watch for Nilgiri tahr on the slopes

stay: Pick a hillside bungalow on the quieter Pallivasal road for valley views.

name: Alleppey
summary: Kuttanad’s canals thread through paddy fields, ferry landings and reed-covered banks. A small canoe reaches the village waterways that a larger houseboat has to pass by.

attractions.title: Punnamada Lake
attractions.text: Watch the practice lanes during snake-boat season

attractions.title: Kuttanad canals
attractions.text: Take a dawn canoe past the rice fields

attractions.title: Alappuzha Beach
attractions.text: Walk the seafront near the old pier

stay: Choose a canal-side homestay or a private overnight kettuvallam.

name: Kumarakom
summary: Kumarakom looks west across Vembanad. The air is coolest on the wetland paths around dawn, when cormorants and egrets start feeding.

attractions.title: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
attractions.text: Walk the shaded wetland trails early

attractions.title: Vembanad Lake
attractions.text: Cruise into open water at dusk

attractions.title: Village lanes
attractions.text: Visit a local coir weaving household by arrangement

stay: Stay in a small lakeside property with its own jetty.

name: Thekkady
summary: The spice shops of Kumily give way to the forests of Periyar. Pepper vines, cardamom and cinnamon are easy to recognise with a plantation guide.

attractions.title: Periyar Lake
attractions.text: Book a forest department boat departure

attractions.title: Kumily spice garden
attractions.text: See how pepper and cardamom grow

attractions.title: Periyar buffer forest
attractions.text: Ask about licensed guided nature walks

stay: Look for a plantation stay just outside Kumily.

name: Fort Kochi
summary: On the Fort Kochi waterfront, cantilever fishing nets still rise and fall with the tide. Follow the lanes into Mattancherry for old spice warehouses and shaded courtyards.

attractions.title: Chinese fishing nets
attractions.text: Walk the waterfront at first light

attractions.title: Mattancherry Palace
attractions.text: Look closely at the Ramayana murals

attractions.title: Jew Town
attractions.text: Visit during synagogue opening hours and browse the spice shops

stay: Stay in a restored courtyard house near Princess Street.

name: Wayanad
summary: The Thamarassery road climbs from Kozhikode into a plateau of coffee farms and forest. Allow time on the bends, especially once the afternoon mist sweeps in.

attractions.title: Edakkal Caves
attractions.text: Climb in the morning to see the petroglyphs

attractions.title: Pookode Lake
attractions.text: Follow the lake trail before the crowds

attractions.title: Lakkidi
attractions.text: Watch mist roll across the escarpment

stay: Choose a coffee-estate guesthouse near Vythiri for two quiet nights.

name: Varkala
summary: Varkala's laterite cliffs meet a long stretch of sea. The northern headland includes quieter paths towards Odayam while Papanasam sees local ritual and beach life.

attractions.title: North Cliff
attractions.text: Walk north to Odayam in the cooler hours

attractions.title: Papanasam Beach
attractions.text: Follow lifeguard directions and local bathing customs

attractions.title: Janardanaswamy Temple
attractions.text: Check visitor and dress rules before a visit

stay: Look for low-rise guesthouses near Odayam for quieter nights.

name: Kovalam
summary: Three scalloped bays curve below Vizhinjam lighthouse. The seafront is best on foot, from the fishing boats near the harbour to the sand at Lighthouse Beach.

attractions.title: Vizhinjam Lighthouse
attractions.text: Climb for a view over the headland when open

attractions.title: Lighthouse Beach
attractions.text: Walk the shore along the cafés

attractions.title: Samudra Beach
attractions.text: Find a quieter cove north of the main promenade

stay: Choose a hillside room overlooking one of the three bays.

name: Vagamon
summary: Rounded grasslands and pine groves make Vagamon a gentler hill stop. An extra night leaves room for a walk between showers and a long tea break.

attractions.title: Vagamon meadows
attractions.text: Walk the grass hills in the morning

attractions.title: Pine forest
attractions.text: Follow the forest path below the old plantation

attractions.title: Thangalpara
attractions.text: Take the rocky trail in dry weather

stay: Book a small cottage near the grassland walks.

name: Athirappilly
summary: The Chalakudy River drops below a wooded escarpment. Spray hangs over the path after the rains and hornbills can be heard along the river road.

attractions.title: Athirappilly Falls
attractions.text: Start at the upper viewpoint and check lower path access

attractions.title: Vazhachal Falls
attractions.text: Visit the river bend upstream

attractions.title: Chalakudy river road
attractions.text: Look for forest birds from designated public stops

stay: Stay near the river or visit as a day trip from Kochi.

name: Poovar
summary: At Poovar the Neyyar flows into a tidal estuary. Routes change with the sandbar and water level, so reserve a boat with a local pilot.

attractions.title: Neyyar backwaters
attractions.text: Take a guided small-boat ride into the mangroves

attractions.title: Poovar sandbar
attractions.text: See the river meet the Arabian Sea when the banks are accessible

attractions.title: Vizhinjam harbour
attractions.text: Stop for the fishing boats on the coastal drive

stay: Try a quiet riverside stay on the inland side of the estuary.

name: Bekal
summary: Bekal Fort's laterite walls look out onto the Arabian Sea. North Malabar rewards a two-night stay, with coastal paths and the backwaters of nearby Valiyaparamba.

attractions.title: Bekal Fort
attractions.text: Walk the ramparts near sunset

attractions.title: Kappil Beach
attractions.text: Take the quieter coastal footpath

attractions.title: Valiyaparamba
attractions.text: Explore the islands by local boat

stay: Book a beachside or backwater stay between Bekal and Nileshwar.

name: Thrissur & Guruvayur
summary: Thrissur’s old centre circles the Vadakkunnathan Temple. Beyond the town, Guruvayur is an important Krishna pilgrimage with its own entry and dress requirements.

attractions.title: Swaraj Round
attractions.text: Walk the ring road around the temple grounds

attractions.title: Guruvayur
attractions.text: Allow time for queues and check entry rules

attractions.title: Kerala Kalamandalam
attractions.text: Ask ahead about guided visits while students are in session

stay: Stay near Guruvayur for an early pilgrimage start.
